decisions.reason: The source changes the token ID displayed by mint-success feedback; it does not change the USDC approval-to-mint flow or its required outcome.
The source concerns a USDC approval and the mint-success popup, not the deferred Transak fiat conversion or supported fiat payment methods.
Correcting the token ID shown in a success popup does not alter mint price, revenue allocation, commissions, or prize-pool funding.
The source explicitly describes the USDC approval path and does not change ETH-funded mint execution.
The popup token-ID correction does not affect automatic fiat-buyer wallet creation, custody, holdings, access paths, or confirmation-email contents.
The source does not change ETH swap input handling, exact-output behavior, shortfall behavior, or excess refunds.
The source does not change currency disclosure, ETH/USDC selection, or the state of the card-payment option.
The source has no effect on the tipping option, its placement, preset amounts, or custom-tip support.
The source reports required success-popup behavior but does not request any corresponding FAQ or other product-copy revision.
Displaying the current minted NFT's token ID in the success popup does not change referral-commission triggers, recipients, amounts, or delivery.
The incorrect number is reported in the success popup, not as an ownership or NFT-count error on the dashboard.
The source requires the popup to show the token ID minted by the current purchase; it does not change the NFT mint number's role as its permanent referral code or any referral-code display surface.
